mapper.insert: insert into post_bookmark_counter_reconciliation(post_id, revision, pending, updated_at) values(#{postId, jdbcType=BINARY}, 1, 1, current_timestamp) on duplicate key update revision = revision + 1, pending = 1, updated_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select post_id, revision from post_bookmark_counter_reconciliation where pending = 1 order by updated_at, post_id limit #{limit}
